meta.title: CVE applicability: distinguish a match from unavailable evidence

cards.title: Preserve the assessment string
items: The Software record distinguishes identity-or-host-unresolved, database-unavailable, lookup-error, no-confirmed-applicability and cpe-product-version (vulnerability/lookup.go:30-71).

The matcher uses explicit CPE product aliases and the stored AND/OR/negation tree. Unknown OS, edition or target prerequisites remain unknown; suffix version ordering is not guessed (internal/vulndb/SCHEMA.md:35-42).
A positive result remains a candidate about installed exposure: backported fixes and real host configuration require verification (docs/vulnerability-analysis.md:30-46).

cards.title: Empty output is not a clean bill of health
items: A missing row may mean that software was not identified, enrichment was disabled, no database was installed, or no match could be established (docs/vulnerability-analysis.md:46).
Retain the capture identity and database release/hash. Updating the database does not re-enrich an existing capture; run the analysis again (docs/vulnerability-analysis.md:8-12).
Software and Vulnerability record writers must be selected to persist their respective observations. The capture-driven lookup does not guarantee a saved row (vulnerability/utils.go:166-197).

cards.title: References are a separate evidence layer
items: Browser/API reference metadata comes from the database installed at browsing time, which can differ from the capture-time snapshot (docs/vulnerability-analysis.md:48-52).
